test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

I was not hired by her.

options.text: She was not been hired me.

solution:
The correct answer is **'She did not hire me'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Simple Past Tense **and in **Passive voice.**
 
• Rules to change a **Passive **voice to an **Active **voice :
 
• The subject and object are interchanged i.e. the subject become the object and the object becomes the subject.
 
• Passive pronouns (her) change to active pronouns (she).
 
• Active pronouns (I) change to passive pronouns (me).
 
• 'By' is removed.
 
• The structure :
 
 
• **Object + was/were+ not +V3+ by Subject **(Passive voice)
 
• **Subject +did+ not+v1+ object **(Active voice)
 
 
• Example- She was not taken by him. (Passive voice)
 
• He did not take her. (Active voice)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In passive voice, a sentence emphasizes the object performing an action.
 
• In active voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
